summary: VivoPower PLC filed a Form 6-K announcing that it has launched a formal competitive RFP process to evaluate prospective tenants for its recently acquired 41.5MW Mo i Rana data center in Norway after receiving strong interest from AI operators. No definitive lease agreement has been signed; the filing describes the selection criteria and asset benefits. The filing is a routine progress update on the company's Power-to-X strategy and does not constitute a special-situations category such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review. There are no deal terms, price per share, or premium disclosed.
